# Public arena placement from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/ap_multipub.c (compiled
# unmodified). This is what decides which arena a player who asked for no
# particular arena ends up in.
#   # <label>: General:PublicArenas = [<raw setting>]  starts a scenario
#   pubnames <n> [<name>]...   the list load_pubnames() parsed, in order
#   arena <name> <total> <playing> <DesiredPlaying>   an arena that EXISTS, with its
#          population; a DesiredPlaying of -1 means the key is unset in that arena
#   place <connectas|-> <return> [<name>] <spawnx> <spawny>   the result of Place()
# Rules these records pin:
#   The list is split on spaces, commas, colons and semicolons, into a 20-byte
#     buffer, so a name longer than 19 characters is TRUNCATED at load time.
#   Place walks passes 1..9, and within each pass walks the names in list order,
#     building '<name><pass>' into another 20-byte buffer -- so the pass digit is
#     what gets lost when a name is near the limit, and two long names can collide.
#   An arena that EXISTS and whose playing count is below ITS OWN
#     General:DesiredPlaying (default 15) wins immediately. An arena that does not
#     exist yet is only remembered as a backup, and only the FIRST such name is
#     kept. So an existing half-full arena always beats creating a new one, even
#     when the new one comes earlier in the list.
#   DesiredPlaying is read from the arena being considered, not from global, so two
#     arenas in the same list can have different thresholds.
#   The 'playing' count is what is compared, not the total, so spectators never keep
#     a player out of an arena.
#   A player who connected through a Listen:ConnectAs port is tried against that one
#     name only, and never against the public list.
#   Place returns TRUE (1) on the immediate win. Otherwise it returns '*retname',
#     the FIRST CHARACTER of the backup name as an int -- not 1, and not a count. It
#     is 0 only when no backup was found at all, which is the real failure case.
#     Callers that test it as a boolean happen to work; one that compares it to 1
#     does not.
#   Place never writes the spawn coordinates, so they keep whatever the caller had
#     in them (-1 here).
# no arenas exist: the first name of pass 1 is the backup: General:PublicArenas = [turf dueling]
pubnames 2 [turf] [dueling]
place - 116 [turf1] -1 -1
# an existing arena with room beats creating a new one: General:PublicArenas = [turf dueling]
pubnames 2 [turf] [dueling]
arena turf1 20 10 15
place - 1 [turf1] -1 -1
# ...even when the arena with room is later in the list: General:PublicArenas = [turf dueling]
pubnames 2 [turf] [dueling]
arena dueling1 20 3 15
place - 1 [dueling1] -1 -1
# a full arena spills into the next pass: General:PublicArenas = [turf]
pubnames 1 [turf]
arena turf1 40 20 15
place - 116 [turf2] -1 -1
# two full passes, third has room: General:PublicArenas = [turf]
pubnames 1 [turf]
arena turf1 40 20 15
arena turf2 40 16 15
arena turf3 40 14 15
place - 1 [turf3] -1 -1
# every existing pass full: the first NON-EXISTENT name is the backup: General:PublicArenas = [turf]
pubnames 1 [turf]
arena turf1 40 20 15
arena turf2 40 20 15
place - 116 [turf3] -1 -1
# DesiredPlaying is read from each arena, not from global: General:PublicArenas = [turf]
pubnames 1 [turf]
arena turf1 40 20 15
arena turf2 40 20 40
place - 1 [turf2] -1 -1
# an unset DesiredPlaying defaults to 15: General:PublicArenas = [turf]
pubnames 1 [turf]
arena turf1 40 20 -1
arena turf2 40 14 -1
place - 1 [turf2] -1 -1
# exactly at DesiredPlaying does NOT count as room: General:PublicArenas = [turf]
pubnames 1 [turf]
arena turf1 40 15 15
arena turf2 40 14 15
place - 1 [turf2] -1 -1
# a packed arena of spectators still has room: General:PublicArenas = [turf]
pubnames 1 [turf]
arena turf1 200 2 15
place - 1 [turf1] -1 -1
# a name longer than the 20-byte buffer is truncated at load: General:PublicArenas = [averyveryverylongarenaname short]
pubnames 2 [averyveryverylongar] [short]
arena short1 40 2 15
place - 1 [short1] -1 -1
# truncation can make two different names collide: General:PublicArenas = [aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaX aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaY]
pubnames 2 [aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa] [aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa]
place - 97 [aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa] -1 -1
# a ConnectAs player is tried against that one name only: General:PublicArenas = [turf dueling]
pubnames 2 [turf] [dueling]
arena turf1 40 2 15
arena vs1 40 2 15
place vs 1 [vs1] -1 -1
# a ConnectAs name that does not exist yet: General:PublicArenas = [turf]
pubnames 1 [turf]
arena turf1 40 2 15
place private 112 [private1] -1 -1
# an empty PublicArenas list places nobody: General:PublicArenas = []
pubnames 0
arena turf1 40 2 15
place - 0 [] -1 -1
